name: find_slots
description: Finds open meeting slots across every invited calendar, skipping holidays and any blocked focus time. Results are sorted by start time.

name: merge_contacts
description: Merges duplicate contacts that share one email address or phone number, then keeps the newest entry. Older entries are archived, not deleted.

name: add_days
description: Adds days to a date, e.g. weekends.

name: pick_source
description: Uses e.g. The calendar feed. Falls back to local time.

name: ping_service
description: Checks that the service is up and answering

name: ask_user
description: Asks the user a question? Waits for the reply! Then returns it. Times out after a minute.

name: export_notes
description:
Exports notes as Markdown.

  Each note becomes one file.

name: Export_notes
description:
Exports   notes as plain	text,
one file per folder.

name: Zeta_sync
description: Syncs the zeta store. Runs nightly.
